embeds.title: ARTICLE XIV — REGULAR SEASON AND STANDINGS
embeds.description:
The regular season consists of **22 scoring periods**. Every franchise plays every other franchise twice.

Regular-season standings and head-to-head results are recorded by Fantrax.

The **Presidents’ Trophy** is awarded using the league’s configured regular-season H2H record criteria.

The **Regular-Season Fantasy Points Leader** prize is based on fantasy points accumulated during the regular season only.
